# Superlinear

> > Superlinear is an AI Operating System (HOLON) platform for enterprise orchestration, automation, and productivity optimization across manufacturing and logistics.

Based in Brussels, Belgium, Superlinear helps enterprises overcome generative AI integration challenges through intelligent orchestration, decision automation, and real-time business metrics. The company combines machine learning expertise with practical enterprise solutions.

## Key Topics

- HOLON (AI Operating System)
- Enterprise Orchestration
- Generative AI
- Decision Automation
- Productivity Optimization
- Machine Learning
- Manufacturing AI
- Real-time MLOps
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- Python Development
- Davio Larnout (CEO)
- Brussels Tech Hub
- Enterprise Software
- Data Integration
- Time Series Forecasting
